unit_label: Struttura della frase: si, passivo, ordine (M&R 17)

blocks.note: Arrange ordinary clauses around theme, given information, and new information, then use a resumptive clitic and a separate intonation group when an object or complement is dislocated left or right. The cleft set is omitted because five of its six items require judgment among printed alternatives; the hygiene gate removes two structurally duplicated solutions from the retained sets.

Choose che plus a finite verb or an infinitive from subject coreference, factuality, register, and the governing verb, then supply no preposition, di, a, dal, nel, per, or da as licensed by that construction.

Use a predicative adjective after verbs of believing, knowing, or declaring, and select the adjective's required preposition before an infinitive while distinguishing an experiencer's action from an action undergone by the modified noun; the hygiene gate removes one already-complete duplicated example.

Build subordinate meanings with avere/esserci da, di sì or di no, a simple or compound infinitive, and the infinitival or finite perception and ecco patterns whose structure matches what is directly perceived.

Choose the tense and mood pattern for open, present-unreal, and past-unreal conditions, then recognize factual se, future-in-the-past, colloquial imperfect, bare-subjunctive, a plus infinitive, and imperative coordination alternatives. The hygiene gate excludes all four judgment-dependent printed alternatives.
